evidence.ACL: Mucoid degeneration of both the ACL and PCL.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: Intrasubstance mucoid degeneration of the medial meniscus, with degenerative meniscal tear; oblique tear at the junction of the body and posterior horn, with a posterior root avulsion.
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: Tiny partial radial tear of the body. Undisplaced oblique tear within the posterior horn.
evidence.Medial OA: Small marginal osteophytes in keeping with mild medial compartment osteoarthrosis.
evidence.Lateral OA: Normal articular cartilage. No established osteoarthrosis.
evidence.PF OA: Small marginal osteophytes in keeping with mild patellofemoral compartment osteoarthrosis.
evidence.Baker's: 6.3 cm popliteal cyst with a trace of edema extending both superiorly and inferiorly consistent with partial rupture.
evidence.Contusion: mild underlying subchondral reactive bone marrow signal changes.
